'''MCR-X Stealth Recon Probe''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] model used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] to conduct surveillance on the [[Star Fortress]]es of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] following the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SF" />
